about: Every file of chronos's runtime/, forge/, scripts/, ui/, desktop/ and docs/, sorted. keep: copied as it is (scripts/sync-check.mjs says when it drifts). reuse: copied, then trimmed here. rewrite: written fresh in Lite. never: a cut part or personal data; it does not ship.

keep.why: the card lock: the same file and rules as full Chronos, so the two never share the GPU
settled renames and writes, used by the trail, the card lock and the beacon
the hardware sense fits() decides with
the JSON POST the brains are spoken to with
the worker loop; the depth and turn caps are set by the runner
the SSE and think-tag splitter the brains' answers are read with
the heat governor every GPU brain runs under
the eight Promethean tools: exactly the tools cap
the chained record of every quest

reuse.why: three brains (0.8B, 4B, 9B), tiers s and m, ports moved by 100 so they never meet full Chronos's
the beacon file; its kind is a parameter so Lite says chronos-lite and is never mistaken for full Chronos
the beacon's tests, plus the kind
llama-server brains under the governor and the card lock; the Colibri path is cut and the lock lives in the full Chronos home
the event bus and its in-memory ring; the ledger's VOLATILE import is cut (no ledger in Lite)
the bus tests without the ledger
the card lock tests on the Lite server and brains
the home and engine facts, plus Lite's own home (CHRONOS_LITE_HOME, ~/.chronos-lite)
the platform tests, plus Lite's home
the runner: split depth 2, 25 brain turns a quest, no l phases' prose
the runner tests on the Lite server, without attachments or l
trimmed to /health, /capabilities, /events, POST /quests, GET /quests/:id, POST /quests/:id/stop; loopback and trustedOrigin kept
the server tests for the routes Lite keeps
two sizes: s and m; l and [size:l] are downgraded to m with a note
the size tests for s and m and the l downgrade

rewrite.why: Lite's own plan is docs/plan.md; the protocol contracts it keeps are the wisp ones
Lite keeps its own build map from stage 1
stage 4: a short install and run guide
the 400-line manifest reaches every part; Lite's is small and built from the edition
stage 4: a short check of the engine, the brains and the card lock
stage 4: the engine and the three brains into ~/.chronos-lite, nothing else
